scope: Exact stage 5 primary-context conditions, neutral carriers and category overrides; existing visual texts unchanged.

entry.en: one teacup vessel with a round opening, continuous curved wall and a joined handle
concept_units: the rim bounds one round vessel opening
a continuous wall connects the rim to the base
the handle joins the same vessel wall

entry.ko: 머리·깃털 몸통·날개·다리가 한 몸에 연결된 새
entry.en: one bird with a connected head, feather-covered trunk, wings and legs
concept_units: the head joins one feather-covered trunk
wings and legs belong to that same bird body
paraphrases: In a sparrow or finch, the head, wing bases and leg bases remain connected to one feathered trunk.

entry.ko: 연속된 잎몸에 잎맥이 분기하는 식물 잎
entry.en: one plant leaf with a continuous blade and branching visible veins
concept_units: one continuous leaf blade carries branching veins
the veins remain part of the same leaf surface

entry.ko: 분리된 단자·도선·눈에 보이는 간격을 가진 시연 회로
entry.en: one demonstration circuit with separated terminals, connected leads and a visible gap
concept_units: separate conducting terminals border one visible gap
each terminal connects to its own lead

entry.ko: 각자의 몸 연결을 유지하는 일반 성인 인물
concept_units: each visible head connects through its own neck to the same person's torso
each visible hand connects through its own wrist and forearm to the same person's arm
separate people retain separate continuous bodies when they share a frame
paraphrases: Adult friends sharing a frame retain separate continuous bodies and distinct hand-to-forearm connections.
A single adult person retains the same head-to-neck and hand-to-forearm continuity.

contextual_usage.definition: Visible human body continuity preserves the frozen people count, identity and actions. It introduces no occupation, performance role, supernatural subtype or age inference from appearance.
